parameters.content:
# SehatDose — Instagram + Facebook Reel Automation

## What this workflow does
1. Runs automatically every 30 minutes.
2. Reads the Google Sheets `Queue` sheet.
3. Finds content whose `publish_date + publish_time` is due.
4. Only processes rows with status `PENDING`, `PROCESSING`, or `FAILED`.
5. Limits each run to one content item.
6. Marks the selected row as `PROCESSING` and increments `retry_count`.
7. Generates Instagram + Facebook captions with the connected AI model.
8. Publishes the Reel to Instagram.
9. Uploads and publishes the Reel to Facebook.
10. Checks Instagram processing status and retries polling when needed.
11. Updates the Google Sheet with per-platform status and final status.

## Important
This template contains NO personal credentials, API tokens, Google Sheet IDs, Instagram account IDs, Facebook Page IDs, or credential references from the original workflow.

After importing, configure your own credentials and account IDs before activating the workflow.

# Google Sheet Setup

Create/use a Google Spreadsheet with a sheet/tab named exactly:

`Queue`

The workflow expects these columns in the `Queue` sheet:

| Column | Required | Purpose | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | YES | Unique content ID; used to update the same row | SD001 |
| `cloudinary_url` | YES | Public/direct video URL accessible by Meta | https://.../reel.mp4 |
| `publish_date` | YES | Scheduled date in `DD-MM-YYYY` format | 24-09-2026 |
| `publish_time` | YES | Scheduled time in 24-hour format | 20:00 |
| `status` | YES | Overall workflow state | PENDING |
| `instagram_status` | YES | Instagram state | PENDING |
| `facebook_status` | YES | Facebook state | PENDING |
| `retry_count` | YES | Number of processing attempts | 0 |

## Valid status values
- `PENDING` — ready to be processed
- `PROCESSING` — currently being processed/retried
- `POSTED` — successfully posted to the platform
- `FAILED` — failed after retry limit

## Date/time
The workflow parses `publish_date` + `publish_time` using the `Asia/Kolkata` timezone.

## Important video requirement
`cloudinary_url` must be a publicly reachable/direct video URL. Meta must be able to fetch the video from that URL without login, cookies, or a private network.

The supplied Excel content calendar uses the same Queue-style scheduling fields. Its additional `instagram_caption` and `facebook_caption` columns are output columns from the automation, not required input columns.

# Credentials & Account Configuration

You must connect your own credentials after import.

## 1. Google Sheets
Configure the Google Sheets credential on:
- `Google Sheets • Get Next Pending`
- `Google Sheets • Mark Processing`
- `Google Sheets • Final Status`

Then select your own spreadsheet and the `Queue` sheet/tab.

## 2. AI model
Configure at least one compatible chat model for:
- `AI • Generate IG + FB Captions`

The original workflow contains Gemini and OpenRouter model branches. Their original credential references have been removed from this template.

## 3. Instagram / Meta
Configure your own Facebook Graph API credential on:
- `Instagram • Create Reel`
- `Instagram • Publish Reel`
- `Instagram • Check Reel Status`

Replace the placeholder Instagram Business/Creator account ID in the relevant Graph API nodes with your own account ID.

Your Instagram account must be eligible for publishing through Meta's Graph API and correctly connected to a Facebook Page/Meta setup as required by Meta.

## 4. Facebook Page
Configure your own Facebook Graph API/Page credential on:
- `Facebook • Start Reel Upload`
- `Facebook • Upload Reel`
- `Facebook • Publish Reel`

Replace the placeholder Facebook Page ID with your own Page ID.

## Never paste secrets into expressions
Use n8n Credentials for access tokens/API keys. Do not hard-code tokens into node parameters, notes, or Code nodes.

# Complete Flow 

### A. Scheduler
`Schedule • Every 30 Minutes`
→ starts the workflow every 30 minutes.

### B. Read queue
`Google Sheets • Get Next Pending`
→ reads rows from your `Queue` sheet.

### C. Select due content
`Filter • Due + Pending`
→ requires:
- scheduled time is due,
- status is `PENDING`, `PROCESSING`, or `FAILED`,
- retry_count is below 5.

### D. Prepare
`Code • Prepare Processing`
→ keeps already-posted platform states,
→ changes unfinished platforms to `PROCESSING`,
→ increments retry_count.

### E. One item per run
`Limit`
→ only one row is processed per execution.

### F. Mark processing
`Google Sheets • Mark Processing`
→ saves the current processing state before external API calls.

### G. Generate captions
`AI • Generate IG + FB Captions`
→ creates exactly:
- `instagram_caption`
- `facebook_caption`

The structured output parser enforces that JSON structure.

### H. Instagram
If Instagram is not already POSTED:
1. `Instagram • Create Reel`
2. `Wait` 30 seconds
3. `Instagram • Check Reel Status`
4. `Instagram • Check Status`
5. If `FINISHED` → publish
6. If `IN_PROGRESS` → wait and check again
7. If `ERROR`/`EXPIRED` → mark failed

### I. Facebook
If Facebook is not already POSTED:
1. `Facebook • Start Reel Upload`
2. `Facebook • Upload Reel`
3. `Facebook • Publish Reel`

### J. Final result
`Instagram • Result` + `Facebook • Result`
→ normalize platform status.

`Merge`
→ combines both platform results.

`Calculate Final Status`
→ final status becomes:
- `POSTED` when both platforms are POSTED
- `FAILED` when retry_count reaches 5 and at least one platform is FAILED
- otherwise `PROCESSING`

`Google Sheets • Final Status`
→ writes the final state back to the matching `id` row.

# First Run Checklist

Before activating:

[ ] Import this workflow.
[ ] Connect Google Sheets credential.
[ ] Select your own Spreadsheet.
[ ] Select/create the `Queue` sheet.
[ ] Confirm the 8 required columns exactly match the documented names.
[ ] Add at least one test row.
[ ] Put a valid public video URL in `cloudinary_url`.
[ ] Use `DD-MM-YYYY` for `publish_date`.
[ ] Use 24-hour `HH:mm` for `publish_time`.
[ ] Set `status=PENDING`.
[ ] Set `instagram_status=PENDING`.
[ ] Set `facebook_status=PENDING`.
[ ] Set `retry_count=0`.
[ ] Connect the AI credential/model.
[ ] Connect Instagram/Meta credential.
[ ] Connect Facebook Page credential.
[ ] Replace the Instagram account ID placeholder.
[ ] Replace the Facebook Page ID placeholder.
[ ] Test manually before activating the 30-minute schedule.

# Common problems

### Nothing gets processed
Check date/time format, timezone, status, and retry_count.

### Meta cannot fetch the video
Make sure `cloudinary_url` is publicly accessible and points directly to the video file.

### Instagram remains IN_PROGRESS
The workflow polls after a 30-second wait and retries polling. Check Meta API permissions and video URL accessibility.

### Row becomes FAILED
Check the execution log for the failed platform. The workflow stops retrying an item after retry_count reaches 5.

### Captions are missing
Check the AI model credential and the `Structured Output Parser`. The expected output keys are exactly `instagram_caption` and `facebook_caption`.

# Safe publishing practice
Test with a non-critical row first. Keep credentials in n8n Credentials, not in workflow JSON or notes.
